001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.jfr;
002
003import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogConfig;
004import io.jstach.rainbowgum.spi.RainbowGumServiceProvider;
005import io.jstach.rainbowgum.spi.RainbowGumServiceProvider.Configurator;
006import io.jstach.svc.ServiceProvider;
007
008/**
009 * Registers a {@link JfrAlertListener} with {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogAlerts} if
010 * {@value JfrAlertListenerBuilder#PROPERTY_enabled} is {@code true}.
011 * <p>
012 * Disabled by default: unlike {@link JfrConfigurator}'s output scheme (inert until an
013 * appender explicitly selects {@code jfr:///}), a listener would otherwise start silently
014 * committing every alert as a JFR event the moment this module is on the classpath, with
015 * no explicit opt-in.
016 *
017 * @see JfrAlertListenerBuilder
018 */
019@ServiceProvider(RainbowGumServiceProvider.class)
020public class JfrAlertListenerConfigurator implements Configurator {
021
022        /**
023         * Default constructor for service loader.
024         */
025        public JfrAlertListenerConfigurator() {
026        }
027
028        @Override
029        public boolean configure(LogConfig config, Pass pass) {
030                var listener = new JfrAlertListenerBuilder().fromProperties(config.properties()).build();
031                if (listener.enabled()) {
032                        config.alerts().addListener(listener);
033                }
034                return true;
035        }
036
037}
